name: buried_verdict
abstract: Reliable estimation is central to model comparison. We examined the dissertation's two methods at n = 1000 using the specified simulation design. The published mean errors were 2.712 and 15.896; ours were 2.730 and 15.938. We replicated the lower error of method A at this condition, but the dissertation-wide robustness claim is not established because two populations could not be evaluated.
introduction: We partly replicated the headline: A had lower error than B at n = 1000 (published 2.712 versus 15.896; ours 2.730 versus 15.938), but robustness across populations is not established.
finding: The abstract begins with background and delays its bounded verdict until sentence 4.
